description: Source code for MAX44009 light sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register read/write, configuration, sampling, and channel data retrieval.

methods.name: max44009_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a register value from the MAX44009 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: max44009_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register of the MAX44009 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: max44009_reg_update
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register of the MAX44009 sensor.

methods.name: max44009_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency.

methods.name: max44009_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new sample from the MAX44009 sensor.

methods.name: max44009_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the sensor data in physical units.
